finding.guards_checked: No @login_required or before_request hook in this file; no comparison of inv['customer'] with g.user['id'] (contrast with /my/invoice at invoices.py:16-17, which does this check). Only 404 on missing id. Caveat: an app-level before_request outside this repo could enforce login, but ownership is still unchecked, so any authenticated user can read any invoice whose ID they know or can enumerate.
